review_description: After searching and engaging with a number of the big players, I was referred to Powerband Electrical via Solar Quotes.They are a local company with a genuine sales team who clearly love what they do and worked with me to plan out my optimal system.The installation team were professional and performed top notch work. The installation of the EV charger was brilliant with all wiring concealed.I have been so impressed that I have referred them to other friends and family considering solar and batteries.Could not recommend highly enough.

Trent was great to deal with, answered all my questions, and came and did a site visit.The installation crew was punctual, polite, tidy, set up the app, and showed us how to use it.Very happy with the entire experience.
Powerband and were excellent and the installation team were great and did an excellent job

Great system was quoted and installed. Took one day for installation of a good-sized system - 30 panels, 24kwh battery, full back up of both buildings on the site, all rubbish removed at the end of the day. System is working like a dream - will eventually get tired of looking at the Sinenergy app. Recommended!

The quoting process was seamless and received 3 quotes from suppliers both local to my area and further up the line. Installation was a breeze. The lads turned up on time, outlined the process and what they needed in terms of access to inside the house. Discussed the best location for the inverter and the place was left neat and tidy after they had completed the installation. Customer service was good, only thing that could have been better was perhaps providing a little more information on how the system works and feedback from the app.
